messages:
Taylor: Quick heads up after onboarding Acme partnerwe hit three related DX issues around embeddings + rerank.

Taylor: 1) Batched embeddings returned mixed vector lengths in one response (one entry was 3-dim, others 768). Happened with batch of 6.

Rina: Oof. Do you have the raw response? Could be a streaming/decoder truncation from a replica.

Taylor: Pasted sanitized response to thread. Also saw a transient 502 just before the bad batch finished.

Jon: 2) JS vs Python rerank helpers diverge: JS auto-truncates long candidates, Python throws. Leads to different rank outputs.

Rina: We should standardize to a single validation behavior across SDKs (default safe-truncate + warn, opt-in strict).

Taylor: 3) Retry stacking: logs show doubled embedding calls on 429s. Looks like transport retry + SDK retry both firing. Cost doubled in staging.

Jon: Short plan: I'll add a small normalization util and unit tests for both SDKs, plus strict-mode flag.

Rina: I'll change retries so transport only retries network errors and SDK handles 429/5xx with idempotency checks. Also add a canary to detect duplicated idempotency tokens.

ops-bot: Created DEVEX-1140: "batched-embed-shape-and-sdk-parity" assigned to Jon/Rina.

Taylor: Immediate mitigation: pin SDK versions in onboarding scripts and assert embedding length == 768 in ingest pipeline.

Jon: I'll open the JS PR with tests and link Python parity patch.

Rina: I'll add a gateway compatibility shim for any key renames (scores -> rank_scores) and add schema CI.

Taylor: Thanks, team. Will add failing minimal repro to the sample app repo tonight. :thumbsup:
